verdict.rationale: Goodwin's Founders Workbench ships Document Driver®, a free self-serve tool that generates real formation documents for a Delaware C-Corp, Multi Member LLC, or Single Member LLC, rather than offering static templates. Its scope is narrow, though, and the evidence only implies the interactive online workflow. Missing for 10: a documented description of the interactive questionnaire and online completion flow, document automation beyond entity formation (e.g., financing or hiring documents), and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, the firm ships self-serve document automation — interactive assembly of real legal documents I can complete online, not just static templates

citations.quote: Our Document Driver® enables you to generate documents to form either a Delaware corporation or LLC.
generates C-Corp, Multi Member LLC, or Single Member LLC formation documents
Our Document Driver® product is the best free tool to get you started with forming a corporation or LLC.
